[[File:Galvatron Rising menu.jpg|thumb|220x220px]]
'''Galvatron Rising''' was a Spotlight Mission that ran from October 5 to November 2 featuring [[Galvatron]]. Unlike the previous Special Missions, all chapters are available from the start, and introduces the Expert difficulty, unlocked at Level 35.

This Spotlight Mission was reran ("ReForged") from March 7 to April 4.

==Transcript==
[[Galvatron Rising/Transcript]]
== Rewards ==

=== Act Completion Rewards ===
* '''Easy:''' 500 Premium Mod Crystal Shards, 2-Star Bot Crystal, 2000 Premium Bot Crystal Shards
* '''Medium:''' 500 3-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 2000 T1 Alpha Spark Essence, Premium Bot Crystal
* '''Hard:''' 5000 T1 Alpha Spark Essence, 2 Premium Bot Crystals, 1000 T3 Basic Spark Essence
* '''Expert: '''T3 Basic Spark, 2 T1 Alpha Spark, 5 Premium Bot Crystals

=== Act Exploration Rewards ===
* '''Easy:''' Galvatron Relic, Premium Bot Crystal, 3000 Premium Bot Crystal Shards, 1000 Galvatron Chips
* '''Medium:''' Bronze Galvatron Relic, 3000 T1 Alpha Spark, 3 Premium Bot Crystals, 3000 Galvatron Chips
* '''Hard:''' Silver Galvatron Relic, 1000 4-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 2500 T3 Basic Spark Essence, 5000 Galvatron Chips
* '''Expert:''' Gold Galvatron Relic, 5000 T2 Alpha Spark Essence, Superior Bot Crystal

==Chapter 1: Rumblings==
[[File:Galvatron Rising Chapter 1.jpg|thumb|256x256px]]
